title.title: Bounded klt complements for Fano contractions
title.subtitle: Claim: every $\varepsilon$-lc Fano contraction has klt complements of index bounded by $d$ and $\varepsilon$

plain: A shape can always be 'completed' to a balanced one using a bounded amount of scaling

lines.tex: f\colon X \to Z \quad \varepsilon\text{-lc Fano contraction},\ \dim X = d

beats.text: A complement makes a Fano-type fibration Calabi–Yau-like near a point
Its index $N$ says how far you must scale before it closes up
Claimed: klt complements with $N$ bounded by $d$ and $\varepsilon$ alone

achievement.label: Shokurov's bounded klt complements conjecture
achievement.context: Before: Birkar (2019) bounded lc complements and proved BAB; klt complements were open
achievement.note: Finite rational coefficients only; also Birkar–Shokurov's Cartier conjecture

verify.detail: No Lean; 199 pages in two papers
verify.ourCheck: We read the claim and caveats; we did not check the proof

voice.text: A complement makes a Fano-type fibration Calabi-Yau near a point.
Its index says how far you must scale before it closes up.
Claimed: klt complements with index bounded by dimension and epsilon.

sources.quote: Birkar (Annals 2019, 'Anti-pluricanonical systems on Fano varieties') proved boundedness of (lc) complements and BAB; bounded klt complements conjecture open
